blocks.text: Lead Tax Group Inc. ("Lead Tax," "we," "us," or "our") provides personal tax filing services to individuals in Canada through multiple service options, including do-it-yourself filing, remote filing, and in-person services.
Some services are delivered using licensed third-party tax technology. Others are delivered directly by Lead Tax professionals.
a) DIY Tax Filing (Powered by CloudTax API)
Lead Tax offers a do-it-yourself tax filing platform powered by CRA NETFILE-certified software using the CloudTax API.
With this service:

items: You prepare your own personal tax return
The software guides you step by step and performs calculations
Your return is submitted electronically to the CRA through NETFILE
Lead Tax provides phone and email support to assist you
You are responsible for reviewing and approving your return before submission.

blocks.text: b) File Remotely (Powered by CloudTax EFILE and Client Portal)
File Remotely allows you to have your tax return prepared and filed by a tax professional without visiting an office.
With this service:

items: You upload documents through a secure client portal
A tax professional prepares your return using CloudTax EFILE
You review and approve the return before filing
The return is submitted electronically to the CRA
This service may be used for more complex situations not supported by DIY.

blocks.text: c) Drop-off and In-Person Services (Provided by Lead Tax)
Drop-off and in-person tax services are provided directly by Lead Tax Group Inc.
With these services:

items: A Lead Tax professional prepares and files your return
Additional consultation may be provided depending on your situation
Fees and timelines may vary based on complexity
These services are suitable for clients who prefer hands-on support or have specialized needs.

blocks.text: Lead Tax services are intended for Canadian residents filing personal income tax returns.
Certain filings are not supported through DIY and may require File Remotely or in-person service, including but not limited to:

items: Corporate tax returns (T2)
Complex CRA elections or special returns
Quebec provincial tax returns
Certain agriculture-related and multi-jurisdiction filings

blocks.text: Lead Tax reserves the right to redirect a filing to the appropriate service channel.
By using Lead Tax, you agree to:

items: Provide accurate, complete, and truthful information
Review your return carefully before approving submission
Maintain the confidentiality of your login credentials
Notify us promptly of any errors or concerns
